# archestra_environment_default (Resource)

The default deployment environment for one resource kind. Declare at most one per resource type. Omitted environment_id selects the organization's implicit Default environment; destroy resets only this resource type and preserves other defaults. Import by resource_type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_environment" "apps" {
  name = "apps"
}

# Manage one default slot per resource type. Destroy restores the implicit
# Default environment for apps and preserves the other resource defaults.
resource "archestra_environment_default" "apps" {
  resource_type  = "app"
  environment_id = archestra_environment.apps.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_type` (String) Resource kind: mcpRegistry, app, agent, mcpGateway, or knowledgeSource.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Default environment ID, or omitted for the implicit Default environment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource type identifying the default slot.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_environment_default.apps app
```
